finding.title: Zero-quality ETF observation still yields full directional score
finding.fixture: ETF BTC net_flow_usd daily USD: 40 +100 observations on days 0..39, distinct record IDs, all available 1h after effective, T=BASE+39d+12h. First 39 data_quality=1.0; final day39 data_quality=0.0. Compare otherwise identical final quality=1.0.
finding.source_predicted: At 24h, both fixtures current_value=+100, 30 trailing windows +100, magnitude_percentile=0.5, direction_score=+0.5, family direction_score=+0.5; zero-quality fixture metric data_quality=0.0 and no quality warning.
expected_assertions: Explicitly gate or flag zero-quality directional contribution; do not treat data_quality=0 as equal-strength validated signal without documented policy.
High-quality fixture remains scoreable with +0.5; no new false flags.
Preserve PIT and cadence handling; quality change alone must be auditable.
finding.evidence: SOURCE_ONLY; proposed quality invariant, not a confirmed incident
